decisions.reason: The corridor effect is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY setting corridor_narrowing_method to the 10 cm wall shift.
The same source separately moves the Unit 3 shower to the left wall, and that effect is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Moving the adjacent room wall to narrow the corridor does not necessarily change the open-plan kitchen cabinetry requirements.
The wall shift changes plan geometry but does not alter the existing requirement to show room dimensions or any of its stored attributes.
The same source separately moves the Unit 3 bathroom drain to the left wall, and that effect is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
